title: ClassWarfare
description:
About This Game — Act 1Act 1 takes the story beyond Dagu Academy and into Emeerie, where scattered classmates, unlikely allies, and an approaching war turn a school reunion into something much bigger.

Explore the outcast settlement of Pontaca, climb through Metroglade’s towering Universitree, and venture into the neon streets and underground prisons of the Hexlands. Reunite with familiar faces and meet Ryan, Gladius, and Dwayne: three very different troublemakers whose arguments, ambitions, and unfinished business might just change the course of your journey.

With war approaching on a thirty-day calendar, decide how to spend the time you have. Follow local stories, strengthen your party, earn a faction’s favor, or build an outlaw organization of your own. Your companions have their own loyalties and limits, and the people you help may remember you very differently from the people you hurt.

There is still time to enjoy yourself before everything goes wrong. Challenge a bard to a performance duel, visit a floating casino, explore strange ruins, or spend a night making memories with your classmates. Expanded class training, faction management, contracts, and new minigames give you more ways to shape your adventure, both in and out of combat.

When the fighting reaches Emeerie, who will be standing beside you, and where will you go together?

Pick a race, class, talent, and starting path, then explore the island one day at a time. Train with classmates, take on strange errands, fight academy assessments, and decide who deserves your trust before the island asks for more than schoolwork.

Combat is turn based and party focused. Ready actions, status effects, class skills, racial talents, pets, summons, and recruited classmates all change what a good turn looks like. Outside combat, your route through the island decides who you meet, what you learn, and what you carry into the final days of the prologue.

ClassWarfare is a free, story-driven RPG about classmates, unlikely allies, and a world where class can become law.

Key Features• Create a student from multiple races, classes, talents, and starting builds.

Recruit classmates with their own roles, personalities, talents, and combat identities.

Fight turn-based battles with ready actions, status effects, skills, racial passives, and ultimate abilities.

Explore Dagu Island across a timed prologue calendar full of events, secrets, and consequences.

Hear original songs used for key story moments, including "The Stars" and "Lanterns Above The Sea."

Complete a free prologue that can export your save for the future main game.

Lore - Prologue

Long before Dagu Academy, the first rune taught mana to obey. What began as discovery became inheritance: a world where power could be shaped, people could be labeled, and class could become law. Across Adytum, nations now worship different parts of the same divine balance — life, order, and destruction — while old forces move beneath the surface. The prologue only shows the first crack: a school where students are told what they are before they understand who they might become.

Lore — Beyond Dagu

Across Adytum, a class is more than a way to wield mana. It can decide your place in society, the knowledge you are allowed to learn, and the future other people expect you to accept. Learning beyond those boundaries can be an act of rebellion.

In Emeerie, those boundaries are beginning to fracture. Metroglade shelters its people beneath the World Tree, the Hexlands turns invention and ambition into power, and Pontaca offers a home to people who do not fit elsewhere. Each has its own idea of freedom, and its own reasons to fear what comes next.

The reach of Capital City draws these lives into a growing conflict. A gunslinger with a grudge, a technomancer who refuses to be claimed, and a would-be hero determined to save strangers become unlikely companions along the way. You can follow their troubles, challenge their choices, or find causes of your own.

What began with classmates learning who they might become now asks a larger question: who gets to decide?
description_short: Choose a class, choose who to trust, and survive seven strange days at an academy where every label becomes a weapon. A free story RPG prologue with turn-based combat, classmates to recruit, and choices that follow you.
